content.title: Put your money to work so you don't get left behind
content.description:
When it comes to the wealth disparity between Black and White families, America has a lot of catching up to do: in fact, the median gap between Black and White households is $172,000, according to a survey from Brookings. On this episode of Decoding Retirement, Robert "Bob" Powell speaks with Chris Wilson, H&R Block franchisee and author of "How To Make Your Nest Egg Last A Lifetime." Chris discusses his strategies for promoting financial literacy, the benefits of opportunity zones, and strategies to help build wealth for the next generation.

Yahoo Finance's Decoding Retirement is hosted by Robert Powell.

Find more episodes of Decoding Retirement at https://finance.yahoo.com/videos/series/decoding-retirement.
